text:
noah: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: can we get a concise contingency checklist for APAC GPU shortages? Customers keep asking about mitigation options and what to expect.
maya: Yep. Short checklist: 1) Confirm whether you need regional isolation; if yes request dedicated cushions via @anya. 2) If latency-tolerant, opt into mixed-SKU burst (V100/T4) in SG/JP. 3) If strict latency required, prepare cross-region failover to AUS/US with expected latency uplift. We'll publish details.
dinesh: To add telemetry and triggers: autoscaler triggers cross-region evaluation when region_available_gpus < 12% AND request_queue_p95 > 700ms sustained for 8m. There's a soft alert at 50% utilization so product teams can opt in/out early.
anya: For customers: two procurement paths — short-term reserved cushions (2-12 weeks) or expedite A100 via partner colo (subject to availability). If you want us to start the short process, DM me customer names + SLA class.
ops-oncall: Implementation notes: when failing over we attach header X-Redwood-Fallback: region=<target>,model=<variant> and emit an event to /events/fallbacks. SDKs will surface a small warning to end-users when sessions resume on a different model. We avoid mid-token swaps; in-flight completes on origin when possible.
noah: Can we get a simple matrix of expected cost uplift by scenario? e.g., mixed-SKU in-region, cross-region burst, forced cross-region with A100 shortage.
maya: Ballpark estimates: mixed-SKU in-region ~+5-12% (lower throughput efficiency), cross-region burst ~+15-35% (egress + remote premiums), forced long-term cross-region ~+30-60% depending on traffic shape. We'll provide per-customer previews next week.
dinesh: Also note: fallback model chain is configurable per-route. Default chain prefers same-family quantized variants, then smaller architecture family. We can expose this override in Console soon.
noah: Perfect. Last ask: can infra publish a runbook and a test harness so product teams can simulate a depletion test?
ops-oncall: Yes. We'll publish a runbook and a smoke harness that simulates regional depletion and mixed-SKU fallback. Send a list of routes + traffic patterns and we'll schedule a canary window.
anya: I'll coordinate with Product and Customer Ops and draft a customer notification template for any forced re-routing.
maya: Action items: infra to publish runbook + procurement ETA doc by COB Wednesday; ops to enable test harness and share instructions; @anya to collect isolation requests. We'll pin links in #announcements.
infra-bot: deployed 2170-apac-fallback-policy to canary (4 nodes) :white_check_mark:
noah: Thanks everyone 97 please pin the runbook and procurement ETA when available.
maya: Will do.
